title: Pearl of Power Amulet
summary: Restore an expended spell slot of level 1, 2 or 3.

fields.Pearlescent Restoration: Action, self, once per Long Rest. Choose a level from 1 to 3. Restores one expended slot at that level. If both ordinary and Pact Magic slots of that level are expended, it restores one of each.
fields.Acquisition: Buy from Omeluum after Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite in Ebonlake Grotto.
fields.Base value: 45 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
